title: CIM-Embed: Learning Instruction-Conditioned Multimodal Embeddings for Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2610.21805v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal objects can require different partitions under different instructions, as when products in an e-commerce catalog are grouped by color, material, or both. Retrieval-oriented embeddings may not recover these partitions, while generative clustering often relies on intermediate descriptions or iterative decisions. This paper presents CIM-Embed, a framework for learning instruction-conditioned multimodal embeddings for clustering. Supervised contrastive learning uses same-group positives and negatives from other groups, optionally including other tasks; heterogeneous structured batches accommodate tasks with different group counts. At inference, the model maps each object's image, text, and instruction directly to an embedding; HDBSCAN then forms a partition without the ground-truth cluster count. translated_title: CIM-Embed：学习面向聚类的指令条件化多模态嵌入
translated_abstract: 多模态对象在不同指令下可能需要不同的划分方式，例如电商目录中的产品可以按颜色、材质或两者兼有的方式进行分组。面向检索的嵌入可能无法恢复这些划分，而生成式聚类通常依赖于中间描述或迭代决策。本文提出了CIM-Embed，一个用于学习面向聚类的指令条件化多模态嵌入的框架。监督对比学习使用同组正样本以及来自其他组的负样本，并可选地纳入其他任务；异构结构化批次可适应具有不同组数的任务。在推理阶段，模型将每个对象的图像、文本和指令直接映射为一个嵌入向量，随后由HDBSCAN在无需真实聚类数目的情况下形成划分。我们基于Amazon Reviews 2023中的产品元数据构建了ProductMIC数据集，包含训练数据以及用于指令引导聚类的评估基准。
tldr: 本文提出CIM-Embed框架，通过监督对比学习将图像、文本和指令直接映射为多模态嵌入，使同一组对象能根据不同指令形成不同的聚类划分，且无需预先知道聚类数目。
